_note: Written directly as a file: this fire had no shell on the device, so review.py open-cycle could not assign the id or stamp it, and no beat was recorded. Cycles remain immutable.
assessment: First dispatcher fire under claude/dispatcher-runbook.md, and it found the loop is built but not connected. Three approved tasks had never been dispatched, so orders/zoltarlead/c-0002.1.md, orders/zoltarone/t-20260908-executor-dispatch-branch.md and orders/zoltargenesis/t-20260908-genesis-inventory.md were written into the clone this fire and posted as dispatch events. None of them can reach a node yet: .git/FETCH_HEAD on this clone is 14.9 hours old and origin/main still reads a3ad2ff here while the board recorded the merge to a246ccf at 13:54, so nothing has entered or left this machine since 05:22 CDT. The courier that would close that hop is t-20260908-courier-zoltarlead, class fleet, priority now, sitting at proposed because L1 does not auto-approve fleet - it is the one click that turns every dispatch on this board into work a machine actually does, and Andrew was on the board 30 minutes ago and approved the consumer (t-20260908-executor-dispatch-branch) without approving the carrier. Meanwhile the irreversible clock is unchanged: c-0002.1 expires around 2026-09-16, eight days out, and c-0007.1 - name the date that runs it - is still open on Andrew. On evidence rather than assertion: zoltarone last heartbeat 2026-09-07T17:00 CDT (22.2 h), zoltargenesis and zoltartwo have no heartbeat file in git at all, so of the four cards only zoltarlead is inside its cadence. This fire could not run review.py or emit_build_status.py - no shell on the device in this session - so this cycle was written as a file and no beat was recorded; the id c-0009 is the next free one and no other writer produces cycles.

items.title: Orders are being written with no transport to carry them: this clone has not fetched or pushed in 14.9 hours.
items.why: The dispatch loop's three hops are board -> order file -> git -> executor. This fire proved hop one works and hop two does not exist on ZoltarLead: FETCH_HEAD is 2026-09-08T00:22 CDT, origin/main here reads a3ad2ff while the board's merge event records a246ccf at 13:54, and fleet/receipts/zoltarlead/ has nothing newer than 00:49. Every order written today is therefore a file on one machine, which is exactly the five-day split-brain that cost this build its cycles - the same shape, now with the plan on the board instead of in a cycle file. It is not a research limit, it is one approval: t-20260908-courier-zoltarlead is class fleet, so L1 will not auto-approve it, and it has waited since 12:27 today while the task that consumes what the courier would carry was approved at 14:41.
items.acceptance: t-20260908-courier-zoltarlead is approved on the board; a later fire reads a courier receipt under fleet/receipts/zoltarlead/ newer than 2026-09-08T15:00 CDT, and orders/zoltarone/t-20260908-executor-dispatch-branch.md is present on origin/fleet/dispatch. Until then no dispatch event on this board may be read as work reaching a machine.

items.title: c-0001.2 has had no event since 2026-09-02T16:44 CDT and is still derived as running.
items.why: Six days with a start and a comment saying 'progress, NOT done' and nothing since. It is the only task holding a node slot on zoltarlead against max_parallel_per_node: 1, and this fire dispatched c-0002.1 to that node anyway because a six-day-silent task is not occupying a machine and the c-0002.1 deadline is irreversible. That judgement is recorded here rather than hidden: if c-0001.2 is genuinely in flight, this fire over-dispatched by one.
items.acceptance: Either an event on c-0001.2 saying where it stands, or a blocked/cancel event closing it.

folded_from_board.title: Install a Claude-free courier on ZoltarLead: commit bridge/ + orders/ + fleet/msgs to fleet/dispatch every 10 min
folded_from_board.why: The db→git hop has no courier on ZoltarLead; that is why five days of cycles never left the machine. A scheduled PowerShell task that only commits and pushes (never runs a model) closes it deterministically. Also runs scripts/fleet_sync.py.
folded_from_board.acceptance: Scheduled task \Zoltar\ZoltarLead-Courier exists (S4U, 10 min, at boot); a file dropped in bridge/dispatch appears on origin/fleet/dispatch within 10 minutes; receipt written on failure too

folded_from_board.title: Dispatcher runbook: brains mirror tasks db→order files and receipts→events
folded_from_board.why: The board is a mirror. A brain with device access must, every fire: (1) read tasks whose derived status is approved and write orders/<node>/<task_id>.md into the clone (or the node's bridge/inbox); (2) read receipts from fleet/bridge/outbox and fleet/receipts-* and post receipt events here; (3) post commit events with the sha once a courier lands them. Genesis's cloud brain is db-only and does neither.
folded_from_board.acceptance: claude/dispatcher-runbook.md in the project; one task round-trips db → order → receipt → event with git_state committed
folded_from_board.board_status: folded from the board into git; the board remains the live copy

folded_from_board.title: Executors take orders from origin/fleet/dispatch, not only from main
folded_from_board.why: Today run-order.ps1 reads orders/<node>/ from the working tree and only pulls when on main — so every dispatch needs a trunk merge, which is the single thing that blocks autonomy. Reading orders from a fetched fleet/dispatch ref (git show origin/fleet/dispatch:orders/<node>/…) makes dispatch trunk-free while main stays Andrew's.
folded_from_board.acceptance: On ZoltarOne and ZoltarGenesis an order pushed to fleet/dispatch is consumed within one cycle with provenance "dispatch" on the receipt; nothing on main changed
folded_from_board.board_status: folded from the board into git; the board remains the live copy

Recreating the task from the desktop app on that machine binds it. Alternative: leave it db-only and rely on the git channel (works today).
